review_kind: Implementation assistant source and applicability check; not independent human review

claims.claim: The existing serving configuration admitted two simultaneous requests to one loaded engine.
claims.basis: Both original concurrent batches sampled vllm:num_requests_running=2, shared the same worker boot identity, and completed matching outputs. Selected measurement derivation is bound to the original profile hashes.
claims.scope: These fixed inputs and this serving configuration; not arbitrary two-agent tasks or peak-memory safety.

claims.claim: The measurements do not establish a reliable speedup.
claims.basis: Round 1 difference is 0.067796 seconds, below the predeclared 0.4-second margin. The original assessment rejects comparability; the imported latency measurements remain unknown.
claims.scope: No post-hoc averaging into a passing speedup claim. Raw timings and the original negative acceptance outcome are retained.

claims.claim: The MCP workflow retains researched context, results and a host interpretation after restart.
claims.basis: Two real stdio processes performed 15 calls, recovered the same frozen-plan/result/note content, accepted identical retries and rejected conflicting history edits.
claims.scope: Software persistence and workflow verification; no claim that the recommendation is better, human-reviewed, or produced by Qwen.
